
```{r Step 1: Cleaning Up the Dataset, include=TRUE}
# Check the variables
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(year = VCF0004, trust_gov_index = VCF0656, trust_gov = VCF0604, econ_views = VCF0870, stock_owns = VCF9224, social_class = VCF0149, person_finances = VCF0880, person_finances_scale = VCF0880a, personal_finances_next = VCF0881, age = VCF0101, age_group = VCF0102, gender = VCF0104, race = VCF0105a, educ = VCF0110, income_group = VCF0114, emp_status = VCF0116, homeowner = VCF0146, marital_stat = VCF0147, partisan_id = VCF0301, partisan_strength = VCF0305, pol_interest = VCF0310, union_mem = VCF0127)

#Turn Dataset into Survey Object

anes_svy

anes_panel %>%
```

```{r Step 2: Model 1 on Relationship between trust in government and views on the national economy, include=TRUE}
year_models <- lapply(
  sort(unique(anes_panel$year[
    anes_panel$year >= 2000 & anes_panel$year <= 2020
  ])),
  function(y) {
    
    # Keep only usable observations for this year
    data_y <- anes_panel %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(trust_gov_index),
        !is.na(econ_views),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )
    
    # Skip the year if there are no usable observations
    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Create the survey design for this year
    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )
    
    # Survey-weighted regression
    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      trust_gov_index ~ econ_views,
      design = design_y
    )
    
    # Extract the coefficient of interest
    broom::tidy(mod) %>%
      filter(term == "econ_views") %>%
      mutate(
        year = y,
        n = nrow(data_y)
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  select(year, n, everything())

year_models

year_models <- year_models %>%
  mutate(
    conf_low = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    conf_high = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

year_models

ggplot(year_models, aes(x = year, y = estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
    width = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Coefficient of economic views",
    title = "Association Between Economic Views and Trust in Government",
    subtitle = "Survey-weighted annual estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#Recoding Variables
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    # Trust
    trust_gov_index = if_else(
      trust_gov_index == 999,
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(trust_gov_index)
    ),

    # Economic views
    econ_views = case_when(
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(1, 3, 5) ~ as.numeric(econ_views),
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Stock ownership
    stock_owns = case_when(
      as.numeric(stock_owns) == 1 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(stock_owns) == 2 ~ 0,
      as.numeric(stock_owns) %in% c(-8, -9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Homeownership
    homeowner = case_when(
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 1 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 2 ~ 0,
      as.numeric(homeowner) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Income percentile group
    income_group = as.numeric(income_group)
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    econ_views_factor = factor(
      econ_views,
      levels = c(1, 3, 5),
      labels = c(
        "Get better",
        "Stay about the same",
        "Get worse"
      )
    ),

    income_group_factor = factor(
      income_group,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "0–16th percentile",
        "17–33rd percentile",
        "34–67th percentile",
        "68–95th percentile",
        "96–100th percentile"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r Step 3: Does Income Moderate the Effect of Economic Pessimism, include=TRUE}
year_income_models <- lapply(
  sort(unique(anes_panel$year[
    anes_panel$year >= 2000 & anes_panel$year <= 2020
  ])),
  function(y) {
    
    # Keep complete cases for this year's model
    data_y <- anes_panel %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(trust_gov_index),
        !is.na(econ_views_factor),
        !is.na(income_group_factor),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )
    
    # Skip years with no usable observations
    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Create survey design for this year
    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )
    
    # Survey-weighted interaction model
    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      trust_gov_index ~ econ_views_factor * income_group_factor,
      design = design_y
    )
    
    # Extract coefficients
    broom::tidy(mod) %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      mutate(
        year = y,
        n = nrow(data_y)
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  select(year, n, everything())

year_income_models <- year_income_models %>%
  mutate(
    conf_low = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    conf_high = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

year_income_models


#Re-estimating Income Moderation Models - Step 1
year_income_svy_models <- lapply(
  sort(unique(anes_panel$year[
    anes_panel$year >= 2000 & anes_panel$year <= 2020
  ])),
  function(y) {
    
    data_y <- anes_panel %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(trust_gov_index),
        !is.na(econ_views_factor),
        !is.na(income_group_factor),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )
    
    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )
    
    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      trust_gov_index ~ econ_views_factor * income_group_factor,
      design = design_y
    )
    
    list(
      year = y,
      model = mod,
      n = nrow(data_y)
    )
  }
)

#Step 2
income_contrasts <- lapply(
  year_income_svy_models,
  function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    marginaleffects::comparisons(
      x$model,
      variables = list(
        econ_views_factor = "reference"
      ),
      newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
        income_group_factor = levels(anes_panel$income_group_factor)
      )
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        year = x$year,
        n = x$n
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()

#Step 4
income_contrasts <- lapply(
  year_income_svy_models,
  function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Get better vs. stay the same
    better <- marginaleffects::comparisons(
      x$model,
      variables = list(
        econ_views_factor = c(
          "Get better", "Stay about the same"
        )
      ),
      newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
        income_group_factor = levels(anes_panel$income_group_factor)
      )
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        contrast = "Get better vs. Stay about the same"
      )
    
    # Get worse vs. stay the same
    worse <- marginaleffects::comparisons(
      x$model,
      variables = list(
        econ_views_factor = c(
          "Get worse", "Stay about the same"
        )
      ),
      newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
        income_group_factor = levels(anes_panel$income_group_factor)
      )
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        contrast = "Get worse vs. Stay about the same"
      )
    
    bind_rows(better, worse) %>%
      mutate(
        year = x$year,
        n = x$n
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()

#Step 5
income_contrasts <- lapply(
  year_income_svy_models,
  function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    income_levels <- levels(anes_panel$income_group_factor)
    
    # Create prediction grid
    newdata <- expand.grid(
      econ_views_factor = c(
        "Get better",
        "Stay about the same",
        "Get worse"
      ),
      income_group_factor = income_levels
    )
    
    # Predictions
    pred <- marginaleffects::predictions(
      x$model,
      newdata = newdata
    )
    
    pred_df <- as.data.frame(pred)
    
    # Calculate contrasts within each income group
    results <- pred_df %>%
      group_by(income_group_factor) %>%
      summarise(
        better_vs_same = estimate[
          econ_views_factor == "Get better"
        ] -
          estimate[
            econ_views_factor == "Stay about the same"
          ],
        
        worse_vs_same = estimate[
          econ_views_factor == "Get worse"
        ] -
          estimate[
            econ_views_factor == "Stay about the same"
          ],
        
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        year = x$year,
        n = x$n
      )
    
    results
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()

income_contrasts

#Step 6

      )
  }
) %>%

income_moderation <- lapply(
  year_income_svy_models,
  function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) {
      return(NULL)

    # Economic-view contrasts within each income group
    comp <- marginaleffects::comparisons(
      x$model,
      variables = list(
        econ_views_factor = "pairwise"
      ),
      newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
        income_group_factor = levels(
          anes_panel$income_group_factor

    comp_df %>%
      filter(
        contrast %in% c(
          "Get better - Stay about the same",
          "Get worse - Stay about the same"

      mutate(
        year = x$year,

) %>%

      x = income_group_factor,
      y = estimate,
      group = factor(year),
      color = factor(year)
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = conf.low,
      ymax = conf.high
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Income group",
    y = "Trust difference: Get worse vs. Stay about the same",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r Step 4: Adding in Asset Ownership to the Model, include=TRUE}
year_stock_svy_models <- lapply(

#Stock Interactions
stock_interactions <- lapply(

        n = x$n
      )

stock_interactions

stock_contrasts <- lapply(
  year_stock_svy_models,
  function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    
    comparisons <- marginaleffects::comparisons(
      x$model,
      variables = list(
        econ_views_factor = "pairwise"
      ),
      newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
        stock_owns = c(0, 1)
      )
    ) %>%
      as.data.frame()
    
    comparisons %>%
      filter(
        contrast %in% c(
          "Get better - Stay about the same",
          "Get worse - Stay about the same"
        )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        year = x$year,
        n = x$n
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()

stock_contrasts <- stock_contrasts %>%
  mutate(
    stock_ownership = factor(
      stock_owns,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Does not own stocks", "Owns stocks")
    ),
    economic_contrast = case_when(
      contrast == "Get better - Stay about the same" ~
        "Get better vs. same",
      contrast == "Get worse - Stay about the same" ~
        "Get worse vs. same"
    )
  )

stock_contrasts %>%

weighted_composition_2008 <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    year == 2008,
    !is.na(stock_owns),
    !is.na(econ_views_factor),
    !is.na(VCF0009z)
  ) %>%
  group_by(stock_owns, econ_views_factor) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    weighted_n = sum(VCF0009z, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_weight = mean(VCF0009z, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_weight = median(VCF0009z, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(stock_owns) %>%
  mutate(
    weighted_pct = weighted_n / sum(weighted_n) * 100,
    unweighted_pct = n / sum(n) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    stock_owns = factor(
      stock_owns,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Does not own stocks", "Owns stocks")
    )
  ) %>%

weighted_composition_2008

#Fuller Diagnostic Table
stock_cell_diagnostics <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    year >= 2000,
    year <= 2020,
    !is.na(stock_owns),
    !is.na(econ_views_factor),
    !is.na(VCF0009z)
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, stock_owns, econ_views_factor) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    weighted_n = sum(VCF0009z, na.rm = TRUE),
    effective_n = weighted_n^2 /
      sum(VCF0009z^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_weight = mean(VCF0009z, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_weight = median(VCF0009z, na.rm = TRUE),
    weight_cv = sd(VCF0009z, na.rm = TRUE) /
      mean(VCF0009z, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, stock_owns) %>%
  mutate(
    weighted_pct = weighted_n / sum(weighted_n) * 100,
    unweighted_pct = n / sum(n) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    stock_owns = factor(
      stock_owns,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Does not own stocks", "Owns stocks")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    stock_owns,
    econ_views_factor,
    n,
    effective_n,
    weighted_pct,
    unweighted_pct,
    mean_weight,
    median_weight,
    weight_cv
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, stock_owns, econ_views_factor)

stock_cell_diagnostics
#We're all good - 2008 was weird because the reference was completely off for intuitive reasons
```

```{r Step 1.5 - Initial Draft Model, include=FALSE}
year_models <- lapply(
  sort(unique(anes_panel$year[anes_panel$year >= 2000])),
  function(y) {
    
    data_y <- anes_panel %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(trust_gov_index),
        !is.na(econ_views),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )
    
    # Skip years with no usable observations
    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )
    
    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      trust_gov_index ~ econ_views,
      design = design_y
    )
    
    broom::tidy(mod) %>%
      filter(term == "econ_views") %>%
      mutate(
        year = y,
        n = nrow(data_y)
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  select(year, n, everything())
```
